request: Prevent immediate commercial tower stair reversal when holding movement; travel should require going farther up the stairs
cause: Every stair arrived at y5 below the reciprocal y4 marker. Continuing Up entered that marker and immediately returned to the previous floor.

implementation.markers: Keep the six existing authored change tiles, link coordinates, destination coordinates, Tiled/PNG files and collision data unchanged
implementation.threshold: Entering the stair marker no longer changes floors. A further Up command from the marker performs the transition.
implementation.arrivalGuard: Per-player WeakMap guard blocks the reciprocal exit while movement continues towards the stairs. A successful step farther away re-arms an intentional return.
implementation.compatibility: Ordinary doors and map transitions retain their entry behavior; no Socket protocol or client change
implementation.runtime: Shared by Adventure, Rift and Colosseum; existing movement cadence and phase/battle locks retained
implementation.persistence: Arrival guards are transient and never serialized. Other map relocation clears them. No schema migration or real account mutation.
implementation.performance: No new interval or animation. Cached change tile is checked before looking up a departure link.

targeted.command: node --test tests/stairways.test.js tests/department-store.test.js tests/player-state.test.js tests/market-layout.test.js tests/drift-runtime.test.js tests/raph-trial.test.js

browser.coverage: Existing real SQL/Socket recipe: all six stair directions in all three modes, 18 mobile pointer-held crossings with exactly one newmap per crossing; normal walking, shop purchases and badge security, stock reload, Center return and separate expedition inventory
browser.visualInspection: adventure-tour_etage1-393.png: landing at the top of the authored staircase, existing art preserved

validation.syntaxAndDiff: node --check on modified JS, deployment helper and git diff --check passed
